text.description_html:
24 Inch Custom Stainless Steel x Teak Door Pull Pair, FII-WST150TEK/LGN150SS4

This custom ladder pull pair is satin stainless steel on the exterior and teak on the interior. Both pulls are 1-1/2" diameter and the overall length is 24" with 18" mounting centers. The pulls come back to back mounted for 3/8" glass doors with 3/8" hole prep and include matching rosettes.

Specifications for the First Impressions Custom Ladder Pull Pair:

  • Pull Handle Material: Satin Stainless Steel and Teak
  • Pull Bracket Material: Solid Stainless Steel
  • Total Length: 24"
  • Center to Center Mount: 18"
  • Pull Handle Diameter: 1-1/2"
  • Total Projection: 2"
  • Clearance: 1-1/2"

Note: This wood door handle is handmade in the USA when you order it—allowing it to be custom designed to fit your specific door application, including Different Wood Types and Other Lengths. Unfortunately, because of the made-to-order nature of the door handle, it is Not Returnable. Please Contact Us with your requirements or if you have any questions.

Sold as a pair
